The card keeps a narrow winning axis against its buyer's alternatives for secure-boot and key storage: a trusted-foundry flow plus magnetic-field immunity versus Toggle MRAM, and no stored charge versus floating-gate EEPROM. C-06 (HZO FeRAM on SkyWater) targets the same buyer slot, and C-22 carries less device risk. The scorer should advance at most one of them.
